steps.text: 11:00 P.M. \ Heavy Rain
Meteor's Dorm Room

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Why is it raining so heavily? I'm freezing. Guess I'll turn on the heater.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Hm... How do I adjust the temperature? Do I turn this little round thing... but which way...?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Maybe this will do it? Eh, I really can't wrap my head around these gadgets. I wish we had a fireplace.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Phew, look at the time. I wonder when Mina gets off work. The Medic operators really have it hard. We're roommates, but we almost never see each other.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Meteor, it's me. Sorry to call this late.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Mina? I thought you were working overtime? What's the matter? Did you forget something?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's Gianna. She's crying her eyes out, and asking for you. None of us can calm her down.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Gianna?! What's the matter? Is she alright? Hang on. I'll get changed and come to Medical right away!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: No, no, you got it wrong, Meteor! She's scared of thunder! Oh, slow down. I'll take her there, okay?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: O-Okay, Mina. Let me talk to her first.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: No problem. Gianna? Meteor wants to talk to you. Here you go.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Meteor, I'm scared! *Sobs*, where are you?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Gianna, don't worry. I'll wait for you here. I'll make you some of that snowy rice milk you like.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: There, there, Gianna. Don't cry. We'll go to Meteor's right now.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: *Whimpers*... I-I'll be strong, Mina... I'll stop crying.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's okay. We'll be there soon.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Mina, it's very cold over here. Did you give her a few more layers of clothes?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Of course. Medical has sweaters just for children. It'll keep her warm and comfy.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Make sure she's wearing socks and everything.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Of course, of course. Okay, Meteor, I need to carry Gianna, so I'm gonna hang up now. I'll see you in a moment.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Okay, I'll wait for you here. See you.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: How am I supposed to stop worrying when all she ever does is cry?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: I guess I'll turn up the heat. We need to keep her warm.
A month ago
Medical Department

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Meteor, could you please take care of this girl for the time being? Please!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: We found her in the ruins. Her family died shielding her when the ceiling fell, and now... Well... she's the only one left.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Well, I definitely don't mind doing that. It's just... why are you coming to me for this? Aren't there professionals in Medical who are better at babysitting?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Medical has actually been pretty overworked lately. I'm ashamed to say this, but we don't have enough manpower, so you're the only one I can turn to.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Oh, right, one second.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: What's this...?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: This is her evaluation. The psychologists at Medical are recommending that we have someone stay with her at all times, but I don't have the time myself. *Sigh*.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Oh, really? Alright, I'll stay with her when you're busy. Thankfully, I don't really have much going on lately.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Thanks, Meteor. She's still a kid. It's not easy for someone her age to accept her family's gone... I'm sure she'll get back on her feet quickly with you by her side.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Is that a compliment? Well, thanks. So where is this girl? Can I meet her?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Of course. Come with me. She's in the ward over here.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: This is the girl?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hey, Gianna? Have you been a good girl and taken your medicine? I brought a new friend with me today.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: I've been a good girl today, Mina... Who is that behind you...?

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Who are you, lady?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Gianna, this is Meteor. She'll be helping me take care of you from here on out. You don't need to be scared. She's patient and kind. You'll like her.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Mina... *Sobs*... I... I'll be okay. I know you're busy. I'll be a good girl. You don't have to worry.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: *Sigh*, Gianna, you're such a sensible girl, it really tugs at my heartstrings.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Meteor, I still have other things to take care of, so I'm going. I'll leave her to you; I'll be back as soon as I'm done.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: See you later, Mina.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Um, Miss... N-Nice to meet you. My name is Gianna, and I'm six!

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Uh, little girl, I...

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: I... I've been taking my medicine, and I'm not picky about food. I-I even learned how to fold roses. Do you like roses? I... I'll give you all of them.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Phew—Ahem, Gianna, is it? Hello, I'm Meteor. You don't have to call me 'Miss' or anything; just Meteor will do.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Meteor...?

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: I know that... you come looking for Mina a lot... I've seen you before. You talk so gentle... I...

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: If you want to, you can think of me as a big sister. I've always wanted a little sister.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: I... May I really?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: *Whimpers*...

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Meteor, I... *Sobs*...

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: What's the matter? It's okay. Tell your big sister everything.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: I-I can't find my doll!

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Ah, I see. Have you talked to Mina about it? Did she help you look?

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: She's very busy... I can't... can't bother her.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: That's okay. How about I go look for it, then?

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: I don't want to look for it anymore. Don't. Don't go, Meteor. Please... Please don't leave me alone.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: I won't go anywhere. It's okay. How about I buy you a new one, then?

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: *Sobs*... I don't want a new doll! I just want a big sister... S-Stay here with me, Meteor. I don't want to be alone.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Don't worry. I'm not going anywhere. I'm here.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: *Sobs*—

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: I'm here. I'm here. Don't worry. You don't need to be scared anymore.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: How come Gianna isn't even wearing socks? Mina, why is she completely barefoot?!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's not my fault! She said she wanted to come look for you, and she ran out the door after she put on a sweater! I couldn't catch her!

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: *Whimpers*, Meteor, I'm scared! That boom is too loud! I'm too scared to sleep!

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: You mean the thunder? Bad, bad thunder. We'll go to the Doctor tomorrow and file a complaint.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Okay, *sobs*...

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Okay now, you two come inside.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I'll pass. Here's her toothbrush. Make sure she brushes her teeth after she's done with her milk, and here's her towel, her socks, her hand puppet, and her feather hairpin.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Okay, I got it. Look at you. You're like her mom.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Eh? Now that you mention it, I guess I'm kinda like one. Hm, okay. Gianna? Mommy still has work to do. Be a good girl here, okay?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Come, Gianna, say bye bye to Mina.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: *Sobs*... Bye, Mila.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's Mina, not Mila! Oh, well. I gotta go back. Good night, Meteor.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Good night. I'll see you tomorrow.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: *Whimpers*, s-see you tomorrow.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Gianna, you're covered in snot. Don't get my pajamas all dirty, okay?

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: I won't... *Sniffs*.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: You know, I can get you some tissues.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Oh, Meteor, it's coming out again!!

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Ahh! Where are the tissues? Right here! Here you go, wipe yourself clean!

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Okay now let's tuck you into bed. Be sure to get your feet in too.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Your blanket is so warm, Meteor, and it smells like roses.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: *Chuckles*, don't be silly.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Come here, Meteor.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: You want a hug?

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Yup!

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: You want me to tell you a story too?

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Yup!

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Be sure to go to bed after the story, okay? You won't be scared of the thunder anymore, right?

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Meteor... Actually, I'm scared because... the same thing happened that day too. Daddy, Mommy, and my big sister all got colder and colder... That's why I'm scared.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: I see... You're scared of the thunder because of what happened...?

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: *Sobs*... I wanna be as strong as you, but I'm not...

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: It's okay. I get scared because of things that happened in the past too, Gianna.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Really? But you always look like you're not scared of anything. How do you do that?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Well, first I think of the things that I'm scared of as big, scary monsters. Then I imagine myself a brave hunter.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: What do you do after that?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Well, this is where I tell you a little story.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: A story? What kind?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Once upon a time, in a big forest in faraway Kazimierz, there was a thick pile of leaves on the ground.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Was there something in the pile?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: A little hunter, shivering...

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Just like me? I'm shaking in your bed.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: You're shaking? Hm, you're right. Your feet are so cold.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Come closer. I'll hold you.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Is it still cold?

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Let's keep going, then.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Our poor little hunter had left home, and she was lost in the forest, all alone. The chilly wind was seeping through her thin clothes, and her hair was completely drenched by the cold rain.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: The sounds of the thunder in the skies high up above were just as loud as the howls of her hungry tummy.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: That sounds so scary.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: No, what's even scarier is that there was a huge, crafty wild beast following the hunter's weak scent, tracking her down.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: It buried its nose in the wet mud and rubbed itself against the coarse tree barks. The bushes, the swamps, the streams. It wasn't going to leave any corner untouched.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Finally, under a dead tree, it finally found it... It found... a foot—!

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Ahh! Meteor, you meanie! Let go of my leg!

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Yep, looks like your feet aren't so cold anymore.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Hmph, I'm putting my feet on your tummy.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Sure thing. Hm, where were we again?

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: The beast found her, and it was going to catch her.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Oh, right. The little hunter was so scared that she was hiding in a pile of leaves. She could already hear the beast's breath and the sounds of its hooves trudging through the mud.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Huff—Huff—

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: *Thump*—

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: The little hunter was too scared to even breathe. Tears dripped down her face one after another.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: The beast had been hunting the hunter day after day, night after night. She managed to get away so many times, but our poor little hunter wasn't going to get away this time.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Don't give up, hunter!

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Right, she can't give up! As soon as the beast bore its fangs, the hunter forced herself to calm down and asked, 'Do I really have my back to the wall?'

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: She held her breath and took out the very last arrow in her quiver. She finally found the courage to take on the beast, looking straight at it through the gaps in the pile of leaves.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Why wasn't she scared anymore?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: She remembered a song that her grandpa used to sing for her.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: What kind of a song is that? Can you sing it for me, Meteor?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: When the little hunter was still a tiny little baby hunter, her grandpa always sang this while he held her: '♪My baby girl, should you find yourself chased through the woods by a beast most vile, under the calm, gentle moon in the sky♪'

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: '♪Never forget, walk forth in big strides. If there is no way to go, turn around not with fright. With your bow and arrow you must fight, and the beast you must smite♪'

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: At that moment, the moonlight lit the way, and the earth helped her lift her shoulders. The little hunter released her bowstring, and the roaring breeze sent her arrow straight into the beast's chest, felling it.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Meteor, did the beast die?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Yes, it did. With that tiny bit of determination and courage, the little hunter defeated the frightening beast in the most decisive moment. And me, that's also how I overcame my past, the past that I used to be scared of.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: And as long as you can muster up the courage, Gianna, you can overcome anything that—

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: But, Meteor, I-I don't want to defeat my past! When I'm scared, it's not just the bad things that I remember. I remember all the happy memories I had with everyone too!

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Doesn't thinking about them make your heart ache, though?

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Yup... it does, and it makes me cry, but it warms up my heart too. When I didn't have you, it was the memories that helped me through everything.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Hmm... really? Looks like... Looks like your little beast doesn't actually want to eat you. Haha.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: I don't think the beast in your story wanted to eat the hunter either.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Hm? What makes you think that?

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: How does the hunter know the beast wants to eat her? She didn't ask the beast, and she's only ever run away. She never tried to talk to the beast.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Well, the beast has been chasing the hunter. What else could it be after, if not eating her?

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: No, Meteor. You said the hunter was scared, cold, and hungry. You never said she was hurt because the beast chased her.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Maybe it thinks the lonely girl needs a friend to help her out of that place.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Please, Meteor. Please don't kill it.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Meteor? W-What's the matter? Why are you so quiet?

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Did I say something wrong?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: No, you reminded me of something, in the past.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Is it a memory that makes your chest burn?

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Yep, it always makes me feel down in the dumps whenever I think about it. That's why I try my best to keep myself from remembering it.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: You can't do that, Meteor.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Yeah, you're right. The hunter was wrong, and I was too. I shouldn't have killed it, and I shouldn't have sealed the memory away.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: All those nights I spent in the wastes, away from my family. The pain, the joy, the sorrow, and the boredom... It was there every moment, and it wasn't there to kill me.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: (I kind of know what Meteor's saying... but also kind of don't.)

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Gianna, I... I just came up with a new ending. Wanna hear it?

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Okay, then. Lie down and get in bed.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: I lied down! My eyes are shut, too! Tell me the story!

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: At the very end, the little hunter took her dagger out, but she didn't use it to stab the beast's heart.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Instead, she cut off a piece of her clothes and bandaged the beast's wound.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: She petted the beast's fluffy head and then asked, 'Can you move, buddy?'

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: The beast pondered a little in silence and then stood up.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Then, she asked the beast, 'I'm going on an adventure. I don't know what lies ahead, but I know I'll need a buddy. Do you want to come?'

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: The beast didn't stay quiet this time. It neighed happily, and it started to sway its tail from side to side, like a whip.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: It ran really fast, and when she rode on its back, it was just like the hunter could grasp the wind.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: She wasn't lonely any more. Together, they ran off toward the sunlight.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Zzz—Meteor... I'm tired.

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Zzzz—

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Are you asleep?

steps.name: Gianna
steps.text: Zzzzz...

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Mina's such a dummy.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: She thinks you aren't strong enough, but you figured out how to confront those things a long time ago.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: (Kisses) But thanks, Gianna.

steps.name: Meteor
steps.text: Thanks...
